sources_used: Prosus FY21-FY25 Annual Reports + H126 results (https://www.prosus.com/investors)
_ordering_rationale: Internet holding : Tencent stake (PV maximale), Trading Profit, OLX classifieds, iFood/food delivery, EdTech.

kpis.signal: 23.7% Tencent post-buyback program, valeur boursière fluctuante mais distribution stake = source dividende
kpis.description_fr: Valeur marché de la participation Prosus dans Tencent (~23.7% au 31/03/2025). Pilier de la NAV Prosus, programme de réduction progressive via buyback Prosus en cours.
kpis.description_en: Market value of Prosus' Tencent stake (~23.7% as of 31/03/2025). Prosus NAV pillar, gradual reduction via Prosus buyback program ongoing.

kpis.signal: Bascule profitable confirmee Ecommerce (iFood + Classifieds + Payments). Plan annonce profitable depuis 2024.
kpis.description_fr: Trading Profit segment Ecommerce (hors Tencent). Bascule profitable 2024 (iFood, OLX, PayU), prouve que Prosus a 'recommencé' la création de valeur opérationnelle.
kpis.description_en: Ecommerce Trading Profit (ex-Tencent). 2024 inflection (iFood, OLX, PayU), proves Prosus restarted operational value creation.

kpis.signal: Leader Brésil food delivery (~80% PdM), profitable depuis FY24, expansion fintech (iFood Pago)
kpis.description_fr: CA iFood (Brésil food delivery). Joyau Prosus Ecommerce, ~80% PdM Brésil, profitable depuis FY24. Expansion vers fintech + grocery.
kpis.description_en: iFood Brazil food delivery revenue. Prosus Ecommerce jewel, ~80% Brazil market share, profitable since FY24. Expanding to fintech + grocery.

kpis.signal: OLX Group consolidé (auto + immo + biens classés), profitable + cash flow positif
kpis.description_fr: CA OLX Classifieds (auto + immobilier + biens classés multi-marchés émergents). Profitable, génère du cash flow réinvesti dans iFood/Stack.
kpis.description_en: OLX Classifieds revenue (auto + real estate + classifieds, emerging markets). Profitable, cash flow funds iFood/Stack investments.

kpis.signal: Payment gateway Inde + EMs, Stitch credit. Cession PayU Global Payments Tech (GPO) en 2024.
kpis.description_fr: CA PayU Payments (passerelle paiement Inde, Amérique Latine, Afrique). Cession PayU GPO Tech 2024 a recentré sur Inde + credit (Stitch).
kpis.description_en: PayU Payments revenue (India, LatAm, Africa payment gateway). 2024 PayU GPO Tech divestment refocused on India + credit (Stitch).

_notes: Prosus FY se termine 31 mars. Sources : Prosus Annual Report FY21-FY25 + H126 trading update.
